# Nursing Uganda

> Structured nursing and midwifery revision courses, free referenced study eBooks, UNMEB mock exams (objective & essay past papers), A-Z medical dictionary (1,079+ clinical terms), medical instrument atlas, and ward dosage tools aligned with Uganda Ministry of Health Clinical Guidelines and WHO protocols.

- Official Website: [nursinguganda.com](https://nursinguganda.com/)
- Support Email: [support@nursinguganda.com](mailto:support@nursinguganda.com)
- Editorial Review Desk: [editorial@nursinguganda.com](mailto:editorial@nursinguganda.com)

## Academic Programmes & Courses

- [All Nursing & Midwifery Courses (83 Units)](https://nursinguganda.com/courses): Certificate in Nursing, Certificate in Midwifery, Diploma in Nursing, Diploma in Midwifery (Extension), and BScN Top-Up study units.
- [Nurse Topics & Clinical Study Notes (779 Topics)](https://nursinguganda.com/topics): Direct browsable clinical topic index across Pharmacology, Midwifery, Paediatrics, Anatomy, Med-Surg, and Community Health.
- [UNMEB Timed Mock Exams & Past Essay Papers](https://nursinguganda.com/mock-exams): Objective Section A mocks plus Section B short essays and Section C scenario essays with itemized marking schemes.

## Free Clinical Study Hubs

- [Free Referenced Study eBooks](https://nursinguganda.com/ebooks): Downloadable printable study guides with WHO, MoH Uganda, and OpenStax/Open RN citations.
- [Free Major Nursing Topic Quizzes (270 Questions)](https://nursinguganda.com/quizzes): Anatomy, Foundations, Midwifery, Pharmacology, Medical-Surgical, Paediatrics, Community Health, and Emergency Care.
- [A-Z Nursing & Medical Dictionary (1,079 Terms · 183 Abbreviations)](https://nursinguganda.com/dictionary): Clinical definitions, phonetic pronunciations, Uganda MoH priorities, exam mnemonics, and ward abbreviations.
- [Medical Images Dictionary & Visual Anatomy Atlas](https://nursinguganda.com/medical-images): Categorized high-resolution human anatomy plates, cellular diagrams, and clinical condition visuals.
- [Medical & Surgical Instrument Atlas](https://nursinguganda.com/instruments): Ward trays, obstetric instruments, suture sets, sterile dressing equipment, and OSCE care guides.
- [Clinical Tools, SI/US Lab Ranges & 8 PDF Templates](https://nursinguganda.com/clinical-tools): IV drip rate calculator, toggleable SI/US lab ranges, emergency checklists, and printable NANDA/Partograph/SBAR/MAR ward templates ([Templates Hub](https://nursinguganda.com/templates)).
- [Becoming a Nurse Globally (8 Countries)](https://nursinguganda.com/global-nursing): Step-by-step registration roadmaps for Uganda (UNMC/UHPAB), Kenya (NCK), Tanzania (TNMC), UK (NMC CBT & OSCE), USA (NCLEX-RN), Canada (NNAS), Australia (AHPRA), and UAE/Saudi (DHA/SCFHS).

## Organization, Governance & Policies

- [About Nursing Uganda & Non-Affiliation](https://nursinguganda.com/about): Mission, independent study scope, and institutional disclaimers.
- [Editorial & Clinical Review Policy](https://nursinguganda.com/editorial-policy): Source vetting across Uganda Clinical Guidelines 2023, WHO, OpenStax, and Open RN.
- [Contact, Student Billing & Legal Desk](https://nursinguganda.com/contact): Direct support channels for PayPal receipts, curriculum feedback, and privacy requests.
- [Terms of Service & Medical Disclaimer](https://nursinguganda.com/terms): Educational scope, refund terms, and clinical disclaimer.
- [Privacy & Cookies Policy](https://nursinguganda.com/privacy-policy): Data handling under the Uganda Data Protection and Privacy Act 2019.
